messages:
claire (infra): FYI aprovision job is failing in ap-se2, about ~30 nodes stuck in a powercycle loop after last night's BIOS+microcode push
jay (sre): saw that. BMC reboots every ~25s, IPMI timing out, can't grab console. provisioning jobs hitting timeout and backing off :grimacing:
claire (infra): logs from one node: ```BMC: watchdog reset; ACPI: PCH state UNKNOWN; secureboot: enforced -> toggled; kernel: GPU init failed - nvme timeout```
ron (hwops): ugh. PCH power policy flip looks like the BIOS update set ACPI _PS0/PS3 thresholds differently; BMC soft-reset on watchdog if it doesn't see expected PWR_OK sequence
mohit (capacity): impact: 30 nodes in ap-se2 were reserved for queued training jobs. Eviction/resize is causing job restarts, cost spike as we spin up fallback in us-west. Est cost delta ~+$1.6k/day if sustained
claire (infra): immediate mitigation: pausing the rollout globally and setting the canary to rollback. Can someone drain the affected hosts and set maintenance tags? I'll add runbook notes
jay (sre): doing drain now. Commands: ```fleet tag add host-apse2-0{21..50} maintenance``` and ```provisionctl drain --force host-apse2-0{21..50}```. Also set BMC debugging: `ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P **** mc reset cold` (will do with stagger)
ron (hwops): vendor told us the signed microcode blob we pushed had a PCH table revision that toggles S3->S0 handshake on some boards. They recommend flashing vendor-signed BIOS 1.1.8 instead of 1.2.3, or toggle a factory jumper if available (not at scale)
claire (infra): ok, rolling rollback to 1.1.8 on canary hosts only, then observe 30m. If green, mass rollback but staggered. Deploy-bot: confirm canary rollback job scheduled?
deploy-bot: deployment rollback job `fw-rollback-20231101` queued for canary hosts (ids host-apse2-021..025). ETA 12m
jay (sre): also opened temporary routing policy to shift new provisioning requests from ap-se2 to us-west-2: `routing.set region_preference ap-se2=avoid,us-west-2=prefer`
mohit (capacity): starting warmup of 40 preemptible GPU slots in us-west-2 to absorb jobs. Will monitor spending and throttle if cost > $2k/day over baseline
ron (hwops): note for runbook: when BMC resets on watchdog, check `ipmitool sel list` for repeated thermal entries; if present, vendor hotfix required. If SEL shows "PCH_PWR_BAD" then do not powercycle more than twice - that can brick some older PSUs
claire (infra): adding runbook snippet now and flagging the release: `release: bios-20231101` -> hold. Also creating a short postmortem board and pinging hw vendor SLA rep
jay (sre): after rollback on canary, I'll run `provisionctl reprovision --test` and verify GPU passthrough with a small restart job. If green, proceed with staged rollback across racks at 10-host batches
mohit (capacity): will keep capacity pool up for 6 hours, then reassess. If rollback fails, we need to budget for extended cross-region shift and open emergency seats with customers. cc @sre-leads
claire (infra): thanks everyone. Action items: 1) ron coordinate vendor rollback flash image 1.1.8, 2) jay drain+verify canary, 3) deploy-bot run rollback job, 4) mohit warmpool and cost watch. I'll update #incidents if we see any escalation. :thumbsup:
jen (notified): tagged for visibility
